tasks.label: build: 调试 Debug (Ninja → build_dbg)
args: Import-Module 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll'; Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community' -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments '-arch=x64'; & 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\Common7\IDE\CommonExtensions\Microsoft\CMake\CMake\bin\cmake.exe' -S '${workspaceFolder}' -B '${workspaceFolder}\build_dbg' -G Ninja -DCMAKE_MAKE_PROGRAM='C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\Common7\IDE\CommonExtensions\Microsoft\CMake\Ninja\ninja.exe' -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=cl -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\Common7\IDE\CommonExtensions\Microsoft\CMake\CMake\bin\cmake.exe' --build '${workspaceFolder}\build_dbg' --parallel
